description: Take a ready-made project's samples away in one action (the demo project's, the board for agents', the register's): every issue of the project labelled 'sample' is deleted as a delete of the issue would — its webhook told, a line in the project's feed — and every current wiki page of its space labelled 'sample' goes to the wiki's trash, from where it can be restored for 30 days. A page you may not delete is left and counted in 'pagesKept'. Issues of your own are kept unless you labelled them 'sample'. With dryRun, only says how many there are. The project's lead, the company's owner or an admin only.

dryRun.description: true to only count the samples and remove nothing. Default false.

name: remove_project_samples
title: Remove project samples
